// Stop - Sequencer (Pipeline Version + PSEUDO step forward / step back)

(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Stop]";

try {

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

return;

}

// Minimal ONI.emit helper

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = function (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

}

const STEP_SQUARES = 0.35; // how far to step (in grid squares)

const POST_CAST_WAIT = 2000; // ms

const EST_CAST_VFX_MS = 900;

const EST_TARGET_VFX_MS = 1800;

const EXTRA_BUFFER_MS = 250;

const HOLD_FORWARD_MS =

EST_CAST_VFX_MS + POST_CAST_WAIT + EST_TARGET_VFX_MS + EXTRA_BUFFER_MS;

const FX_CASTER =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Cast/CastShapeSquare01_01_Regular_Blue_600x600.webm";

const FX_TARGET =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Energy/IcosahedronRoll_01_Regular_Blue_600x600.webm";

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Beginspell.mp3";

const SFX_POISON =

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Condition_Poison.ogg";

const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const isUuid = (v) => typeof v === "string" && v.includes(".");

async function resolveToken(ref) {

if (!ref) return null;

if (ref?.document && ref?.object) return ref;

if (ref?.id && canvas.tokens?.get(ref.id)) return canvas.tokens.get(ref.id);

if (isUuid(ref)) {

const doc = await fromUuid(ref);

if (!doc) return null;

// ONI — Divination (with timing hooks)

(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][FX]";

const FX_BURST = "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Particles/ParticleBurstStar01_01_Regular_BluePurple_600x600.webm";

const FX_CIRCLE = "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Cast/CastShapeCircleSingle01_01_Regular_Blue_600x600.webm";

const SFX_START_1 = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Up3.ogg";

const SFX_START_2 = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Starlight.ogg";

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error(`${TAG} Sequencer module is not active.`);

return;

}

const targets = Array.from(game.user.targets ?? []);

if (targets.length !== 1) {

ui.notifications.warn(`${TAG} Please target exactly 1 token.`);

return;

}

const token = targets[0];

const center = token.center;

const squaresUp = 0.9;

const yUpPx = canvas.grid.size * squaresUp;

const locAbove = { x: center.x, y: center.y - yUpPx };

const locOn = { x: center.x, y: center.y };

// ✅ Tell the handler “animation started”

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationStart", { tag: "Divination", tokenId: token.id });

const seq = new Sequence()

.sound().file(SFX_START_1).volume(0.8)

.effect().file(FX_BURST).atLocation(locAbove).scaleToObject(1.3).anchor({ x: 0.5, y: 0.5 }).opacity(1.0).belowTokens(false)

.wait(1500)

.sound().file(SFX_START_2).volume(0.8)

.effect().file(FX_CIRCLE).atLocation(locOn).scaleToObject(1.8).anchor({ x: 0.5, y: 0.5 }).opacity(0.5).belowTokens(false);

// IMPORTANT: await play so we can emit “end” at the true end

await seq.play();

// ✅ Tell the handler “animation ended”

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationEnd", { tag: "Divination", tokenId: token.id });

})();

props.name: Prophetic Defender
props.description:
Your maximum Hit Points are permanently increased by an amount equal to your base Insight die size (update your maximum HP if this size changes).

When a conflict scene begins, if you have learned the Divination spell, you gain 1 Prophecy Point. You also gain 1 Prophecy Point at the start of each even-numbered round (regardless of whether you have learned Divination). You lose all Prophecy Points at the end of each scene.

When one or more allies are threatened by a single attack, spell, or other danger, you may spend 1 Prophecy Point to take the place of all those allies (any Checks that are part of the danger will be performed against you; you may declare the use of this Skill before or after the Checks have been made). The danger will affect you once for each creature it was threatening (including yourself, if you were among those creatures). Resolve each of these instances separately.
